financial.title: Financial data API
financial.scope: Connect Finnhub to add available company metrics and news to research evidence. Research still marks missing data clearly.

financial.removeDescription: Your Finnhub key will be deleted. Future research will show data gaps wherever a financial source is needed.

guide.title: How to connect your APIs
guide.intro: You only need the credentials for the services you want to use. These links open the providers' official sites.

llm.title: 1. Connect an AI model
llm.step1: Choose a provider with an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint. Create an API key in its console, and make sure the account can call your chosen model. A chat subscription may be separate from API billing.
llm.step2Title: Copy the API base URL and model IDs
llm.step2: Use one of the examples below or the URL shown in the provider's documentation. Copy the exact model ID, not the model's display name. The fast and deep model can be the same.
llm.step3Title: Fill in the four fields above
llm.step3: Paste the base URL, fast model ID, deep model ID, and key. Select Save settings. You can replace a key later by entering a new one; an empty key field keeps the saved key.
llm.step4: Select Test connection to make a small model request. If it fails, check the key, endpoint, model permissions, balance, and provider availability. Once it passes, open AI Analysis or use a research prompt in Agent Builder.

financial.title: 2. Connect Finnhub data
financial.step1: Register on Finnhub and find your API token in your account dashboard. Review the endpoint documentation and your plan's access.
financial.step2: Paste the token into the Financial data API field above and select Save settings. The field clears after saving; that is expected.
financial.step3: Select Test connection. Squabble asks Finnhub for a small sample of company data. A success means the key works for that test; other endpoints can still have plan or coverage limits.
financial.step4Title: Check the evidence in AI Analysis
financial.step4: Run research for a supported US ticker such as AAPL and inspect the cited financial and news evidence. Missing fields remain labeled as data gaps. This key does not change paper or real order execution.
